transformations.rationale: Adapted the inherent `&mut self` receiver to the explicit harness receiver `slice: &mut [T]`; no target semantics were changed.

Lowered the Rust `let slice: *mut [T] = self` raw-provenance scaffold to an executable `RustSliceRawPtr` token constructor whose only postcondition is the non-mutating slice-frame fact; the raw write/effect model remains isolated in the unsafe fill/assume_init boundary.

Lowered the `MaybeUninit<[&mut I::Output; N]>::uninit()` and `arr.as_mut_ptr()` scaffold to executable local token constructors; actual MaybeUninit raw storage/write/assume_init effects remain in the retained unsafe fill boundary.

Isolated the unsafe source loop over `0..N`, unchecked index cloning, unchecked mutable slice indexing, raw `cast/add/write`, and final `arr.assume_init()` in one named boundary guarded by the generated disjoint/in-bounds precondition.
